question: What are the statuses, dates, and shipment dates for all invoices?

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE invoices AS SELECT CAST(invoice_number AS BIGINT) AS invoice_number, CAST(invoice_status_code AS VARCHAR) AS invoice_status_code, CAST(invoice_date AS VARCHAR) AS invoice_date FROM invoices

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE shipments AS SELECT CAST(shipment_id AS BIGINT) AS shipment_id, CAST(order_id AS BIGINT) AS order_id, CAST(invoice_number AS BIGINT) AS invoice_number, CAST(shipment_tracking_number AS VARCHAR) AS shipment_tracking_number, CAST(shipment_date AS VARCHAR) AS shipment_date FROM shipments

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH shipment_min AS (
    SELECT invoice_number, MIN(shipment_date) AS first_shipment_date
    FROM shipments
    GROUP BY invoice_number
)
SELECT i.invoice_number,
       i.invoice_status_code AS invoice_status,
       i.invoice_date,
       s.first_shipment_date AS shipment_date
FROM invoices i
LEFT JOIN shipment_min s USING (invoice_number)
ORDER BY i.invoice_number

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH shipment_parsed AS (
  SELECT

    COALESCE(
      TRY_STRPTIME(shipment_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'),
